calculation.description: Negate each instrument's trailing five-session return and amplify reversal exposure when the cross-asset average five-day volatility is high relative to its trailing 120-session history. All inputs use completed sessions only.

parameters.dispersion_measure: cross-sectional mean of 5-day rolling daily-return standard deviations

validation.regime_notes: Daily paper IC and ICIR exceed benchmark-wide admission gates of absolute IC 0.0070 and absolute ICIR 0.0840. Annual daily IC remained positive in 2020 (0.070939), 2021 (0.053948), 2022 (0.057813), 2023 (0.059076), 2024 (0.011792), 2025 (0.041511), and 2026 (0.023904). The 15-instrument cross-section was available on 2434 valid dates. Correlation provenance scan reports max absolute correlation 1.0, so deterministic post-Miner audit must assess redundancy.
